about_the_game:
🌊⚓ Cardbreaker Command Pinball⚓🌊

🔥 Lead your fleet to victory in this high-seas pinball showdown! 🔥

Step into the command center of a naval warzone with a stunning Navy-themed pinball table, packed with 🛳️ battleships, ✈️ aircraft carriers, and ⚙️ military-grade detail. Designed for precision and chaos, this table drops you into the heart of sea warfare with immersive visuals, interactive challenges, and explosive missions 💣.

🚢 Key Features:

  • 🌀 Tactical Ramps & Targets
    Strategically fire the ball across ship decks, through radar rings, and around compass-laden bumpers 🧭.

  • 🎱 Realistic Pinball Physics
    Smooth ball control, ricochet chaos 💥, and multi-ball action deliver a satisfying and responsive play.

  • 🔊 Dynamic Visuals & Sound
    High seas come alive with captain voiceovers 🎙️, sonar pings 📢, engine roars 🛞, and sea-shanty soundtracks 🎶.

⚔️ Ready your crew. Prime the cannons. Launch the mission. Your Navy legacy begins on the table. ⚔️

🔐 Codebreaking Mini-Games

Decrypt transmissions using in-game puzzles tied to the physical playfield—Morse, Vigenère, sonar pings, and more. The Decoder Room awaits.

🔥 Crack the code. Command the fleet. Climb the ranks in this tactical naval card battler! 🔥

Step into the war room and rise through the ranks—from a green Ensign to a decorated Admiral—as you master the art of naval warfare through cards, codes, and cunning. Decrypt encrypted transmissions, deploy devastating fleets, and earn your place in the Legendary Signature Pelican Club 🪖🧠💥.

🚢 Key Features:

🗝️ Codebreaking Warfare
Intercept enemy signals and crack naval ciphers using decoder cards and logic puzzles. Every transmission is a battlefield.

🎴 Strategic Card Combat
Build your fleet with destroyers, sonar disruptors, traps, and recon planes. Outsmart your rivals through deception and precision.

📡 Progressive Rank Advancement
Climb the naval ladder from Ensign to Admiral by completing missions and proving your command skills. Each rank unlocks powerful new abilities and rare tactical cards.

🪖 Enter the Legendary Signature Pelican Club
Only the best make it here. This elite circle of admirals unlocks exclusive perks, top-secret missions, and rare gear reserved for naval legends.

⚓ Dynamic Naval Theaters
Battle across radar-saturated waters, fog-heavy island chains, and stealth-based submarine zones.

🎯 Asymmetric Command Roles
Choose your specialization—Cipher Expert, Fleet Strategist, or Tactical Disruptor. Each brings unique abilities and deck styles.

🔊 Immersive Audio & Visuals
Morse transmissions, sonar pings, and brass command-room aesthetics bring naval warfare to life.

🎙️ "From a green Ensign to a Pelican legend—your legacy begins with a code."

⚔️ Decode. Dominate. Rise through the ranks. This is your command. ⚔️

From Ensign to Admiral—crack the code, command the fleet, and join the Legendary 🦤 Signature Pelican Club.

Instructions: ( Keyboard Keys )

S - Left Flipper

D - Left Tilt

L - Right Flipper

K - Right Tilt

Enter - Ball Plunge
